subject: Preflight: Evidence routing and sampling proposal for ISO/FedRAMP
messages:
From: Marcus Hale <audits@brightaudit.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Preflight: Evidence routing & sampling for upcoming ISO/FedRAMP scoping

Hi Soojin,

We're kicking off preflight scoping for the ISO 27001 / FedRAMP engagements and need to confirm routing and sampling approach for evidence collection.

Can you confirm:
- Primary control owners for encryption/KMS, logging/retention, and privileged access
- Preferred window for snapshot exports (we prefer 7/16--7/20)
- Any enclave boundaries or environments that need separate sampling (prod, prod-PII, staging)

Attached is a short questionnaire and a sample evidence checklist. Please return by EOD 7/9 or let us know if you need more time.

Attachments: preflight_questionnaire.pdf (stub), preflight_checklist.xlsx (stub)

Thanks,

Marcus Hale
Engagement Lead, BrightAudit
audits@brightaudit.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Preflight: Evidence routing & sampling for upcoming ISO/FedRAMP scoping

Hi Marcus —

Thanks for the checklist. We can support the 7/16–7/20 snapshot window. Quick answers below and a proposal for next steps.

- Control owners: encryption/KMS — Kimberly Park; logging & retention — Jonas Weber; privileged access (IAM) — me (Soojin Lee).
- Enclave boundaries: we will treat 'prod-PII' as a separate boundary; prod and staging can be sampled together.
- Snapshot exports: Jonas will coordinate exact times; we prefer early-morning windows to minimize load.

Next steps:
1) Quick 30m call to lock owners & exact export windows (propose Wed 7/3 10:00 PT).
2) We'll upload a mapping of evidence locations and a small sample bundle to the shared Drive link below before 7/9.

Attachments: preflight_checklist.xlsx (uploaded)

Thanks,

Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jul 2028 15:20:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Preflight: Evidence routing & sampling for upcoming ISO/FedRAMP scoping

Marcus,

Following up on encryption/KMS specifics — a few clarifying points and what we'll include in the evidence bundle:
- KMS: We use AWS KMS with a customer-managed key in the shared account. I'll include key rotation records, policy JSON and KMS CMK ARN screenshots.
- Logs: Our retained logs (WAF, ALB, application) live in centralized S3 buckets with 365-day retention. For FedRAMP, we can provide the 90/365 extraction per control as requested.
- Snapshots: We will provide point-in-time AMI lists and database snapshot manifests for the sampling window.

Please confirm if you need HSM attestation docs for the KMS key (we can provide a vendor statement) or if the KMS artifacts above suffice for initial scoping.

On Wed's call we can walk through the exact artifacts and I will own the encryption/KMS evidence set.

—Kimberly
